name.zh: Williamsonia 本内苏铁类种子球果

description.en: An ovulate fossil cone has a receptacle crowded with scales and seed-bearing units.
description.zh: 胚珠化石球果的承托体密集着生鳞片和带种单元。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Williamsonia bockii, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Williamsonia bockii 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: A discrete stalked reproductive body differs from Cycadeoidea's embedded trunk structures and true conifer scales.
distinctness.zh: 独立有柄生殖体区别于Cycadeoidea嵌入干体的结构及真正针叶树球果鳞片。

modeling_brief.en: Use a compact receptacle with a coarse tessellated surface; avoid treating it as an angiosperm daisy.
modeling_brief.zh: 用紧凑承托体及粗镶嵌表面建形，不将其当作被子植物雏菊。

uncertainty: Known cone specimen only; not the detached cone of the counted Wielandiella reconstruction.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Anatomically preserved Williamsonia: evidence for Bennettitalean reproduction
sources.supports: Williamsonia bockii ovulate cone with densely packed scales and terminal ovules.
